INSERT INTO reading_progress (user_id, book_id, page, cfi, percent, updated_at)
           VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, NOW())
           ON CONFLICT (user_id, book_id) DO UPDATE SET
             page = EXCLUDED.page,
             cfi = EXCLUDED.cfi,
             percent = EXCLUDED.percent,
             updated_at = NOW()
